moworks.notes: Dot travels a quadratic arc (start (270,160) → end (70,60), control (250,50) on a 320×200 stage: the mid-point sits ~50 px off the chord) in 1200 ms power2.inOut, beside a grey dot on the straight chord. Recipe: 900 ms sine.inOut with the mid-point 10–20 px off (15 px); thrown objects follow a parabola. Params: duration (0.9 s) · offset: lệch điểm giữa (15 px) · ease (sine.inOut).
